function: Upsamples sparse CSI-RS downlink CSI to full subcarrier-level CSI at the gNB, suppressing aliasing with uplink CSI as side information, in the CSI feedback pipeline (pp. 1, 6).
system: Massive MIMO FDD, gNB with 8x4 UPA or 32-element ULA, single-antenna UEs, QuaDRiGa 3GPP TR 38.901 UMa, 667 subcarriers at 15 kHz, carrier frequency not stated (p. 10).
method: Supervised end-to-end training on upsampling NMSE: SRCsiNet (3-conv learned bandpass filter plus SRCNN-based refinement) and SRISTA-Net (ISTA-Net deep unfolding with reciprocity block) (pp. 7-10).
data_channel: QuaDRiGa 3GPP TR 38.901 UMa simulated dataset, 2000 UEs x 16 TTIs = 32,000 channels; 80% train, 10% validation, 10% test (p. 10).
test_conditions: Trained and tested on the same UMa dataset with a held-out split; evaluated per delay-spread cluster, CSI-RS density, virtual pilots and time gaps; no unseen scenario (pp. 10-12).
baselines: Non-learned: linear interpolation, UL masking (own rule-based). Learned: SRCNN [25], ISTA-Net [22]; end-to-end with DualNet-MP feedback (pp. 10-11).
metrics: NMSE in dB of full DL CSI upsampling, feedback and end-to-end, by delay-spread cluster; model parameters and FLOPs (pp. 10-11).
complexity: Table IV: SRCsiNet 7K parameters, 3.1M FLOPs; SRISTA-Net 215K parameters, 2.01G FLOPs; interpolation 109K and UL masking 206K FLOPs (p. 11).
q1_support: p. 10: "The scenario features given in 3GPP TR 38.901 UMa were followed" and "We generated the outdoor datasets using QuaDRiGa channel simulators [41]".
q2_support: p. 10: "We used one-tenth of the channels for testing and validation, respectively"; all results use the same QuaDRiGa UMa dataset (pp. 10-12), no unseen scenario, band, or configuration is tested.
q3_support: p. 11: "compared to traditional interpolation"; p. 11: "SRCNN [25] and a deep unfolding framework, ISTA-Net [22]"; NMSE compared in Fig. 14 (p. 10) and Table I (p. 11).
q4_support: p. 13: "Table IV outlines the complexity and storage requirements of all previously mentioned approaches"; p. 11: Table IV lists parameters and FLOPs for each method.
q5_support: p. 10: "We generated the outdoor datasets using QuaDRiGa channel simulators [41]"; a self-generated dataset, and the paper gives no code or data link.
notes: Included, area 2: CSI upsampling and recovery for CSI feedback. UL masking is rule-based, the learned methods are SRCsiNet and SRISTA-Net. q2=0: delay-spread clusters CL1-CL3 are subsets of the same test data (p. 11); Table III (time gaps, p. 11) does not state training on a different gap, so it is not counted. q5=0: QuaDRiGa data generated by the authors, not released.
